IS 2963 : 2013 : Copper Alloy Waste Fittings and Waste Plug for Wash Basin and SinksICS 91.140.70CED 3(Amalgamating IS 3311 : 1979)Reaffirmed 20181 SCOPEThis standard covers the requirements for materials, manufacture, workmanship, nominal sizes and dimensions, finish and testing of copper alloy waste fittings and waste plugs to be used in wash basin and sinks complying with IS 771 (Part 2), IS 2556 (Part 4) and IS 2556 (Part 5).2 REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contains provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
